text: Fang's pregnant!! Due March 2027. She's been really sick in the mornings, poor thing, so keep the coffee invites low key for now.
christening for Obi and Ifeoma's little boy is Sunday 15 November 2026, St Anne's at 11. need to find a card + something silver
Pick up dry cleaning tomorrow before 5, then post office for the passport form.
Lila's daughter Phoebe started reception on Monday. Lila said she cried at the gate, Phoebe didn't even look back lol
Mohammed mentioned his eldest, Chidi, has his driving test next Thursday. Third attempt so he's properly nervous. Text Chidi good luck Wednesday night.

Dawit graduates from Leeds in July 2027, engineering. First in his family to go to uni, his mum is beside herself and has apparently already bought a hat. He's got a grad scheme lined up at an engineering firm in Sheffield starting September 2027, but he's not sure he wants to stay up north. Told him to come round for dinner over Christmas and we'd talk it through. He likes Ethiopian coffee, the proper ceremony kind, worth remembering.

So I was talking to Sophie after the school run and she told me Amara, her sister, had the baby on Saturday, a little girl, seven pounds two. Everyone's fine but Amara's exhausted and the older one is apparently not thrilled about sharing. Sophie's going up to Manchester this weekend to help. I should send something for Amara, maybe a meal delivery rather than more baby clothes.
bridget - grandson's GCSE results thurs. she's more nervous than he is
Remind me to ask Nikhil how the scan went yesterday.
Tadhg and Mariam are expecting twins!!! told me at the pub, due date is 2 May 2027. Tadhg looked terrified
Layla's son Juan got into the grammar school. Results came through Friday morning. Send her a congrats text.
Hannah has been struggling since the baby came, not sleeping, says she feels a bit lost. Her partner is back at work on the 3rd. Must ring her next week, maybe drop round with soup.
Gustavo's graduation ceremony was meant to be 12 December 2026 but it's been called off because of the strikes. Rescheduled to January, date tbc.
Need to renew car insurance by Friday 30 October 2026. Also book MOT.
Jonah - goes by Jo - is doing his first triathlon in a fortnight. Bit wobbly about the swim part.
Nikolai's little one, Ioana, is one on Saturday 7 November. Party at theirs at 2. Gift idea: she's obsessed with anything that has wheels, Nikolai said a push-along walker would be a hit.
tanvi = vegetarian, no eggs either. remember for the christening lunch
Hoang said his wife Nadia is 20 weeks now, they find out the sex at the scan next Tuesday. He wants a girl, she says she doesn't mind.
Thabo's daughter finished her PhD!! Viva was last Wednesday, passed with minor corrections. Proud dad energy all over the WhatsApp group.

Voice note. Um, so Phoebe's mum, Mrs O'Brien, rang about the nativity, Phoebe's an angel this year, the show is the Thursday before we break up, so 17 December 2026, at 2pm. I'm taking Phoebe's gran because Mrs O'Brien's working. Need to sort a costume, white sheet and tinsel apparently.
Emre and his wife are moving to Bristol in March 2027 so the baby can be near her parents. He's a bit sad about leaving the team.
Aleksander started at the new school Monday. Ioana says he came home and talked non-stop, so that's a relief.
Ioana Popescu, Aleksander's mum. Works as a midwife at the Royal. Loves sea swimming, does it all year round.
Groceries for the weekend, return the library books, cancel the gym direct debit before the 1st.
Nadia's cat Biscuit had kittens on Sunday! Five of them. She's keeping one and asked if I want one... thinking about it.
Don't forget Joe's son's first day at nursery tomorrow, ask Joe how it went on Wednesday.
Chidi Okafor and his wife are christening baby Ada on 22 November 2026. We're godparents!! Must get the outfit sorted and look up what godparents actually do.
juan says catalina's waters broke this morning, on the way to hospital now. text later
Heather - retired teacher, two grandkids, mad about crosswords. Lives next to the church.

Fang texted, the 12 week scan was fine, all good. She's telling her parents at dinner this weekend, which she's a bit nervous about because her dad wanted them to wait until after the wedding. Her husband Hoang is apparently already reading every baby book going and has a spreadsheet for names. She said she can't face coffee at all at the moment, only peppermint tea. Ask her on Monday how the dinner went.
Book the plumber for the boiler service. Thursday afternoon or next Monday, whichever he can do.
Mohammed's wife Heather is due any day now. He's on paternity leave from Friday. I should drop off the hamper we got before the baby arrives.
Lila says Phoebe's 7th birthday is next Saturday. Phoebe wants a unicorn cake and 'a real microscope'. Microscope might be the gift then.
Amara is back home with the baby. Sophie says she's doing better, the midwife visit Tuesday went fine.
Obi asked if I'd do a reading at the christening. Said yes. Nervous already tbh.
Ifeoma's mum is flying in from Lagos next week for the christening, staying till mid December.
Graduation photos from Dawit's sister Mariam came through, she graduated from Glasgow on Thursday, nursing. Message Dawit to say congrats to her.
Nikhil found out it's a boy. Due date moved to 18 February 2027. He's already painting the nursery green.
Tadhg's sister Bridget is getting married in June 2027, so twins will be about a month old. He's dreading the logistics.
Mariam's off work from the end of November. She's been told to rest more because of her blood pressure. Check in with her after the next scan on the 9th.
Bridget's grandson got 9s in maths and physics! Results were Thursday. She was beaming at church.
Layla - nickname Lay - wants to start a mum's running group in January 2027. Asked if I'd help with flyers.

Hannah's baby boy is 6 weeks today. She said the health visitor is coming Friday to weigh him, and she's finally getting the odd four hour stretch of sleep. Her mum's been staying since the birth and goes back to Cork on Sunday, which Hannah is quietly dreading. She asked if I knew any baby groups near Hillfoot, I said I'd ask around. Should send her the details for the Thursday one at the library.
Dentist 3:15 tomorrow. Then pick up the cake from Gail's. Then home to wrap stuff.
Gustavo is still upset about the graduation being postponed, his parents had already booked flights from São Paulo for December. Remind me to message him at the weekend.
jonah's partner Tanvi passed her midwifery exams!! qualified as of last Friday. need to get a card for her

Long one. Nikolai and his wife Catalina had a scare with the baby last week, a high fever and they ended up in A&E on Tuesday night. She's fine now, it was an ear infection, antibiotics. But Catalina's understandably shaken and Nikolai's trying to hold everything together while doing night shifts. Their party on the 7th is still on, smaller though. I should offer to bring food so they don't have to cater.
Hoang's daughter Lila has her ballet exam on Saturday 14 November 2026. Grade 2. She's been practising in the kitchen every night apparently.
Thabo mentioned his wife Amara is pregnant again, due in June 2027. Their son Obi turns four next month.
Emre's boss gave him an extra two weeks paternity, so he's off until mid January now.

Return the pram to Ioana. She lent it for the visit last month and needs it back before her sister arrives on 5 November 2026 with the new baby. Her sister's coming over from Cluj for three weeks and Ioana's taking the whole time off, first proper holiday in two years. Wash the rain cover first, it's filthy. And put a little thank you in the basket, she loves those salted caramel things from the market.

Nadia started a part-time course in early years education, Tuesdays and Thursdays, evenings at the college. Wants to open a nursery one day, ideally in the old bank building on the high street. She's juggling it with the job at the pharmacy and her two kids, so it's a lot, but she sounded happier than I've heard her in ages. First assignment due 13 November 2026.
Joe said his boy settled at nursery after a rocky first week. Still won't eat the lunches though.
Chidi's mum, Mrs Okafor, is doing all the food for the christening, jollof for 80 people. I'm bringing the drinks.

Catalina had the baby! A boy, Emre after his grandad, born 4:12am Monday. Juan sent about forty photos. Organise a card from everyone at work and get flowers for Catalina. She'd been in labour since Saturday afternoon so she's wiped out, but they're hoping to be home by Wednesday. Juan's mum is staying with them for the first fortnight. Catalina hates lilies, go for something without a strong smell.
Heather's granddaughter Tanvi is sitting her 11 plus on 12 September next year, so September 2027. Heather's a bit anxious, Tanvi's very relaxed about it.
Sort the spare room before mum comes on Friday. Wash bedding, clear the desk, buy a new lamp.
Phoebe and Joe ... wait no, it's Phoebe Shah, from Pilates. Her husband's just been made redundant and she's three months pregnant. Bad timing. She's putting a brave face on it.

Sophie's twins start secondary school next September. She's already worrying about the bus route, and the open evening is next Tuesday at 6, so she's going with Gustavo and both kids. One of them wants the school with the drama department, the other wants to follow his mates, so it's going to be a long autumn. Applications close 31 October 2026. She asked if I'd read over the personal statement bits on Sunday.
Mention to Fang that Ioana's a midwife, she might like to chat to her before the birth in March.
